actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (RNA metabolic/repair reprogramming, PBRM1-enriched WXS, CDKN2A/9p-9q CNV), no per-set technical confounder association, and positive fused boundary margins with moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.72). Silhouette magnitudes are small, so uncertainty remains, but no material unresolved question requires an available request and no better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0002 has coherent RNA-defined identity (inflammatory downregulation, metabolic upregulation) with a distinctive low-12p/CDKN2A-loss-depleted CNV profile and no per-set technical confounder association. Internal resampling stability is modest (ARI 0.46) and CT/WXS modality support is near zero, so structure is uncertain, but the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation and no available request would resolve this.

C0003 shows coherent immune/inflammatory RNA activation with a striking BAP1-enriched, PBRM1-depleted mutation pattern, no per-set technical confounder association, and the most stable internal structure (ARI 0.75, PAC 0.36) with positive boundaries. Silhouette magnitudes are small, so uncertainty remains, but no material unresolved question requires an available request.

C0004 has a coherent defining WXS signal (strong PBRM1/VHL depletion) with very strong WXS modality support (0.52) and good resampling stability (ARI 0.76), and no per-set technical confounder association. RNA and CNV do not corroborate membership, so cross-modal structure is uncertain, but the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation and no available request would resolve this.
